goal: Make Hermes the senior board and durable orchestrator for bounded Codex and Claude work across the MacBook and Mac mini, with provider-neutral continuity, independent verification, and founder-only consequential approvals.

win_condition.text: Founder intent becomes a versioned mission and board packet within 60 seconds.
Every mission carries objective, authority, non-goals, done criteria, sources, evidence requirements, and 15-20 anticipated moves.
Retries and duplicate intake resolve to one active attempt and one active owner.
Codex or Claude produces a candidate only in an isolated worktree and returns an exact-diff/test receipt.
A different model family reviews the frozen candidate and cannot approve its own authored work.
Deterministic verification reruns after candidate freeze and outranks model opinions.
A complete redacted receipt records mission, actor route, machine, commits, commands, exits, hashes, verdict, and next action.
MacBook sleep or disconnection does not stop admitted work on the Mac mini.
Worker crash or Mac mini restart recovers within ten minutes without duplicate external action.
Broken model, MCP, network, GitHub, or Linear routes produce visible bounded blockers, never silent success.
Merge, production, spend, credentials, publication, destructive, and privilege actions remain founder-gated.
Worker identity cannot read Phill's user home, broad credentials, or verifier state.
STOP completes within 60 seconds and preserves ledger and evidence integrity.
Five supervised canaries complete with zero duplicate execution, missing receipts, policy escapes, or failed recovery tests.

moves.title: Ratify the architecture and bounded authority
acceptance: The exact architecture, acceptance criteria, migration boundary, test strategy and prohibited actions are approved by the phrase approve architecture HSBC-1.
evidence: Approval message ID and immutable design commit.

moves.title: Freeze the MacBook runtime inventory
acceptance: Record Hermes profiles, gateway, Kanban, MCPs, auth classes, scheduled loops, launchd services, Codex and Claude routes without credential values.
evidence: Redacted inventory receipt and exact command exits.

moves.title: Read-only inventory the Mac mini over Tailscale
acceptance: Verify named Tailscale device, SSH reachability without agent forwarding, host identity, Hermes/Codex/Claude state, service managers, storage and runtime constraints without mutation.

moves.title: Freeze one-ledger authority and projection rules
acceptance: CRM is mission authority, Hermes Kanban is execution projection, Wiki is doctrine, Git is delivery evidence and Linear is an engineering projection.

moves.title: Version the Senior Board five-part contracts
acceptance: Each board role declares inputs, outputs, authority, prohibitions and escalation paths.

moves.title: Align Second Brain retrieval across Hermes, Codex and Claude
acceptance: All three runtimes retrieve the required page IDs and revisions and produce matching content digests; Claude's current failed MCP path is repaired.
evidence: Three connector health receipts and digest comparison.

moves.title: Define provider-neutral mission, handoff, receipt, lease and machine schemas
acceptance: Schemas are versioned, secret-free, source-commit-bound and reject malformed or incomplete state.
evidence: JSON Schema or equivalent types plus valid/invalid fixtures.

moves.title: Create the RED continuity suite
acceptance: Tests fail for duplicate intake, dual claim, stale lease, worker crash, malformed receipt, self-review, secret request, gated action, provider outage, knowledge mismatch and forged verifier result.
evidence: Fresh RED test command with expected failures.

moves.title: Build the offline reconcile-first dispatcher with fake adapters
acceptance: Offline tests pass with no network, live CRM, credentials, service installation or external mutation.
evidence: GREEN unit/property test receipt and exact diff.

moves.title: Build bounded Codex and Claude worker adapters
acceptance: Adapters use fixed argv, bounded runtime/iterations, route attestation, redaction, isolated worktrees and no merge/deploy authority.
evidence: Adapter contract tests and adversarial review receipt.

moves.title: Build the Mac mini dedicated worker identity and sealed workspace
acceptance: Dedicated identity, sealed HOME/workspace, pinned binary digests, fixed tools and deny-by-default egress are independently proven; the worker cannot read Phill's home.
evidence: Permission-denial tests, binary hashes, egress tests and threat-model review.

moves.title: Build the operation-scoped credential broker
acceptance: No general Supabase service role, broad GitHub PAT, browser, SSH, payment, social, email or deployment credential enters the child; grants are mission/verb scoped, expiring and revocable.
evidence: Deny tests, expiry/revocation tests and names-only credential audit.

moves.title: Build the independent verifier in a separate trust domain
acceptance: Verifier retrieves artefacts independently, reruns pinned checks, validates hashes and model-family separation, and cannot be modified or impersonated by the worker.

moves.title: Install the Mac mini dispatcher disabled by default
acceptance: Service starts disabled, admits no live task, exposes bounded health, and passes STOP/rollback without plaintext backups.
evidence: Service-state, no-admission, STOP and restore receipts.

moves.title: Run one supervised offline real-agent mission
acceptance: Hermes creates one projection, Codex produces a frozen candidate, deterministic checks rerun, Claude independently reviews and a valid receipt reconciles without external mutation.

moves.title: Run fault injection and restart recovery
acceptance: Kill-worker, duplicate-tick, MacBook-sleep, Tailscale-loss, Mac-mini-restart, provider-outage, MCP-outage, malformed-evidence and policy-injection cases all fail or recover exactly as specified.
evidence: Fault matrix with fresh exits, timings and receipts.

moves.title: Run five supervised low-risk canaries at concurrency one
acceptance: Five consecutive canaries have zero duplicate execution, missing receipts, policy escapes or failed recovery tests, with every intervention documented.
evidence: Five immutable canary receipts and one roll-up report.

moves.title: Present the unattended low-risk widening decision packet
acceptance: Board packet compares canary evidence to every win condition, lists residual risks and seeks a new explicit approval; consequential gates remain manual.
evidence: Founder decision and signed rollout scope.

non_goals: No second orchestration framework or second authoritative queue.
No production mutation, merge, deploy, publication, spend or credential migration under this architecture approval.
No claim that an installed CLI, active profile, healthy login or green model opinion proves safe execution capacity.
No plaintext credential backup or broad ambient environment inheritance.
